caption: A lit lantern is lowered into a well on a rope, and the circle of lit stone around it slides down the shaft.

sa.check: A lit lantern is lowered into a well on a rope.
The circle of lit stone around it slides down the shaft.
The wall above darkens as the lantern passes.

pc.expect: The brightest ring of wall is level with the lantern and moves down with it, and the wall above darkens as it passes.
pc.fail: The light stays at the top; or the whole shaft is lit evenly; or the bright ring is far from the lantern.

pc.expect: The lit ring moves only as the lantern moves.
pc.fail: It moves with the lantern still; or before the lantern; or jumps.

pc.expect: The rope stays taut and straight above the lantern.
pc.fail: It goes slack while the lantern hangs; or stretches; or bends.

pc.expect: The lantern hangs below the rope and goes down.
pc.fail: It rises; or hangs sideways; or floats.
A second lantern appears; or the rope vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The well's stone and the lantern stay the same.
pc.fail: The stone changes; or the lantern changes colour; or the rope changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
